title: Add global interface zoom controls

commits.message: docs(release): attach mark commit to CHG-20260726-005
docs(evidence): record interface zoom RC2 candidate

user_summary: 在设置-外观中增加界面缩放（默认80%），并支持 Ctrl+/-/0；合法已保存偏好不覆盖。
technical_summary: Add browser-like global interface zoom via Tauri Webview.setZoom (CSS zoom fallback). Settings key storylens.appearance.interfaceZoom; levels 80/90/100/110/125/150. Default interface zoom changed from 100% to 80%. Existing valid user preferences are preserved. Reset and Ctrl+0 restore the product default of 80%. Early apply in index.html; reading fontSize/lineHeight remain independent. Targets 1.1.0-rc.3.
acceptance_criteria: Settings Appearance shows 界面缩放 with 80-150 presets
Ctrl+Plus / Ctrl+Equal / Ctrl+Minus / Ctrl+0 work; clamp at ends
Zoom persists in localStorage and restores on restart
正文字号 and 行距 remain independent
Default / missing / invalid → 80%; existing valid prefs preserved; reset and Ctrl+0 → 80%; 100% still selectable
tests: vitest interfaceZoom + SettingsAppearanceZoom: 10 passed; typecheck pass
vitest interfaceZoom + SettingsAppearanceZoom + shortcuts: 13 passed; typecheck pass; vite production build pass
